_comment: Per-repo manifest for roadmap 2.30. The docs-sync agent maintains the `modules` list; docs_freshness.py reads it to compute coverage + freshness. Each module maps one doc file to the code path(s) it documents. This is DisplayNote's QXmpp fork (branch 1.6): the library lives in src/ (base, client, server, omemo); agent docs live under docs/ (upstream's Doxygen input in doc/ is out of scope).
